en.headline: Police arrest man over fatal Route Twisk crash
en.dek: Officers held a 36-year-old man at the airport on suspicion of dangerous driving causing death, after a motorcyclist died following a Route Twisk collision.
body: Police have arrested a 36-year-old man over a fatal collision on Route Twisk, a day after a motorcyclist died in hospital.

The crash happened at about 9.26pm on Wednesday near Shek Kong Tsuen in Pat Heung. A 35-year-old man was riding toward Tsuen Wan when police believe he was struck by the side mirror of an oncoming light goods vehicle, lost his balance and fell. The goods vehicle did not stop. Reports described it as a 5.5-tonne truck.
The rider, injured in the hands and legs, was taken to Pok Oi Hospital. He died at 12.04am on Thursday, police said.

The New Territories North traffic special investigation team arrested the 36-year-old man, who is not ethnically Chinese, at Hong Kong International Airport on Thursday afternoon. He was held on suspicion of dangerous driving causing death and detained for inquiries. Police did not name him.

zh.headline: 荃錦公路致命車禍 警方機場拘捕36歲男子
zh.dek: 八鄉荃錦公路周三晚發生致命交通意外，電單車司機送院後不治。警方周四下午在機場拘捕一名36歲非華裔男子，涉嫌危險駕駛引致他人死亡。
body: 荃錦公路致命交通意外有新發展。警方周四下午在香港國際機場拘捕一名36歲非華裔男子，涉嫌危險駕駛引致他人死亡。
意外於周三晚上約9時26分發生，地點在元朗八鄉石崗村對開。一名35歲男子駕駛電單車沿荃錦公路往荃灣方向行駛，警方相信他被對面線一輛輕型貨車的側鏡撞到，失平衡倒地。涉事貨車沒有停下並駛離現場。報道指該車為一輛5.5噸貨車。
電單車司機手部及腳部受傷，送往博愛醫院治理，延至周四凌晨零時04分不治。
新界北總區交通部特別調查隊人員經調查後，在機場拘捕該名男子，並把他扣留調查。警方沒有公布其姓名。
